construct.claim: For sufficiently large n, any exact cubic-stage residual has more than floor(log2(n)/4) variables uncovered by complete triple blocks.
construct.scope: Same universal U, actual explicit selector order, all satisfiable source formulas at sufficiently large n; probability statement only for the specified planted distribution.
construct.derivation: Complete blocks force three bits, logarithmic remaining assignment search is charged O(n^(5/4)L polylog L) on fixed multitape machine, quadratic tape simulation yields O(L^(17/6) polylog L), included in same U stage three.
unresolved_steps: Unconditional unbounded B_3 existence or universal polynomial cutoff.

alternative.claim: Uniform planted ternary selectors fail the exact cubic stage with probability at most exp(-Omega(n^2 log n)); the same asymptotic upper bound holds uniformly over uniquely satisfiable ternary-only selectors.
alternative.scope: Independent selection of each clause true under a uniformly planted witness; conditioning on unique models removes multiplicity.
alternative.derivation: Complete support indicators independent with probability 1/128; for r uncovered vertices all intersecting triples incomplete; union bound and positive unique probability.
unresolved_steps: No lower bound on residual count or efficient sampling of rare bad selectors.
candidate_tests: Exact weighted uncovered histograms and all small-r union bounds.
